scope_notes: Upstream tool, resource and prompt catalog scenarios inspect the first response page only. Reported counts are page counts; full discovery pagination and the 17-tool admin catalog are verified separately by product transport and live E2E tests.
The fixture registers production tools, resources, prompts and shipped skills through the actual MCP Handler. Domain data is inert; protocol catalog responses are not canned.

server-stateless.sep-2575-server-rejects-undeclared-capab: Requires upstream test_missing_capability tool; product does not request sampling.
server-stateless.sep-2575-missing-capability-http-400: Requires upstream test_missing_capability tool; product does not request sampling.
server-stateless.sep-2575-http-server-no-independent-requ: Requires upstream test_streaming_elicitation tool; elicitation is not offered.
server-stateless.sep-2575-server-no-log-without-loglevel: Requires upstream test_logging_tool; product has no logging tool.

excluded_groups.reason: Upstream scenarios call artificial test_* tools absent from production. Product tools, errors, progress and cancellation are covered by Go transport tests and live MCP E2E tests; this does not establish these upstream requirements.
Upstream expects test:// fixture resources. Product resources and polling subscriptions have separate transport and live E2E contracts. Legacy subscriptions are not advertised.
Upstream expects fixture prompt and resource names. Actual prompts and completions are checked in product transport tests.
Optional directoryRead capability is not advertised; every shipped skill file is available through resources/read.
